preconditions.description: N (number of tasks) is between 1 and 10^5, and M (number of dependencies) is between 0 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[2:2+N]) == N and all(e in {0, 1} for e in map(int, stdin.split()[2:2+N]))
preconditions.description: The next line contains exactly N integers, each either 0 (main processor) or 1 (coprocessor).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(t1) < N and 0 <= int(t2) < N and int(t1) != int(t2) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:] for t1, t2 in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each dependency line contains two distinct task indices T1 and T2, both in [0, N-1].

preconditions.expression: len(set((t1, t2) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3:] for t1, t2 in [line.split()])) == int(stdin.split()[1])
preconditions.description: All M dependency pairs are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of coprocessor calls, bounded by N.
The output is the minimal number of coprocessor calls required to execute all tasks, respecting dependencies and processor constraints.
